dict.string: Acorn needs microphone access to capture your voice notes.
Acorn uses macOS on-device speech recognition to transcribe your voice notes locally. Your audio never leaves your machine.
Acorn syncs your task cards with Apple Calendar so scheduled tasks show up as events.
Acorn syncs your task cards with Apple Reminders so tasks show up as reminders with due dates.
